title: 6.1 Places Around Town
unit_outcome: Name places and transport, explain a current destination, complete a trip, follow directions, ask for help, choose a service and check its times.
goal: Name useful places, locate familiar people, and connect a place with a familiar need.
grammar_function: Ana and her family make a short neighborhood visit. Start at the station, locate the father at the bank and the mother at the pharmacy, find the children at the library, then meet at the mall and get food at the supermarket. Explicit Spanish transitions explain each change of location; the English stays within the early lesson’s scope.
prerequisite: Units 1–5 and the earlier Unit 6 lessons in the displayed course sequence.
speaking_outcome: Name useful places, locate familiar people, and connect a place with a familiar need.
